==Description==
This template is designed to help users properly cite [[canon]] dating for material from the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series]]. It covers:
*The [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|theatrical film]]
*All of the 133 televised episodes of the series (Seasons One through Seven)
*The 8 Story Reel episodes released as part of [[The Clone Wars Legacy|''The Clone Wars'' Legacy]] multimedia project
*All 4 issues of ''[[Star Wars: Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir]]''
*''[[Dark Disciple]]''

To keep the site's articles up to date with canon sources, this template will be updated as new information is released.

==Usage==
Use the following code, making sure that it is properly formatted as a [[Wookieepedia:Sourcing|reference note]]. For the 133 televised episodes, "''EPISODE NUMBER''" should be a three-digit number, the first digit being the season number and the other two digits being the individual episode number, e.g., 105 for "[[Rookies (episode)|Rookies]]" (Season 1, Episode 5).
 <nowiki><ref>{{</nowiki>TCWcanondates|''EPISODE NUMBER''}}</ref>

Any pages that do not use the template correctly will be placed into [[:Category:Invalid TCWcanondates parameter arguments]].

The table below lists the usage codes for material other than the 133 televised episodes.
